Missing layer, in order: (1) a transport formula expressing `(CechNerve 𝒰 F).map φ` through `pushPull_sigma_iso` as a matrix of restrictions `pushPullObj F (Over.mk j_σ) ⟶ pushPullObj F (Over.mk j_τ)` (only `pushPull_sigma_iso_π`/`_π_incl` exist, in `CechSectionIdentificationBase/Leg`); (2) per-σ restriction compatibility of the heavy per-σ isos (`pushPullObj_coverInter_baseChange`, `twisted_cech_nerve_per_sigma`) — coherence through the `AffinePushPullEssImage` essImage/adjoint constructions. Estimate: multi-hundred LOC each; one focused session per leaf at best.\n- **Heart-closure recipe that landed** (session 0011 surgery, verified 0013): paste `restrictedCartesianAffinePushout` onto the ambient square (`IsPullback.paste_vert`), convert with the converse `isPushout_of_isPullback_SpecMap` (`IsPullback.of_map_of_faithful` on `Scheme.Spec`, then `.unop.flip`), identify the pullback corner with `coverInterOpen 𝒰' σ` via the slice iso, rewrite corner sections (`coverInterOpen_baseChange_restrictedMap_comm` + `pullbackRestrict_iso_tilde` + `pullback_spec_tilde_iso`), finish with `affinePushforwardPullbackBaseChange`. `set_option maxHeartbeats 800000` scoped per declaration suffices."

  "id": "I-0313",
  "kind": "memory",
  "status": "open",
  "body": "Lean --profile output order does not localize async kernel time\n\nIn Lean 4.31, `Elab.async` defaults to true and `Lean.addDecl` queues each kernel check asynchronously. The legacy `--profile` wrapper for `type checking` supplies no declaration name, so its bare `type checking took ...` line may be printed after later command elaboration. For `CechSectionIdentificationLeg`, the ~1300 s entry proves the file is kernel-check dominated, but placement after `cechNerve_drop_δ` alone does not distinguish that lemma from the later WPCI declarations. Localize with a scratch prefix or `set_option Elab.async false in` around the candidate before redesigning it; if confirmed, split the definitional conversion at `cechNerveCosimplicial`."
}
{
  "id": "I-0118",
  "kind": "issue",
  "status": "open",
  "body": "QuotScheme statement is unprovable-as-pinned: properness alone is not the Nitsure theorem\n\nThe pinned AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.QuotScheme (QuotFunctorDef.lean, final theorem) hypothesizes only [IsProper pi] [LocallyOfFiniteType pi] with arbitrary quasi-coherent L and arbitrary E, but the source theorem ([Nitsure] Sec. 5, thm:quot_representable) requires pi projective, L relatively very ample, E coherent. For merely proper X the Quot/Hilbert functor is in general only an algebraic space (Hironaka's smooth proper non-projective 3-fold is the standard counterexample family), so the pinned statement is false-or-open, not the cited theorem. Same trap genus as the old Grassmannian.representable skeleton corrected this session (GrassmannianRepresentability.lean, thm:grassmannian_representable NOTE). Next action before attacking this sorry: design the projectivity / relative-very-ampleness encoding (absent from Mathlib v4.31, see I-0109 ampleness gap), restate faithfully, then prove. Do NOT close the sorry as stated."
}
{
  "id": "I-0106",
  "kind": "memory",
  "status": "open",
  "body": "**T13 genus-0 / Route-C retirement: `WeilDivisor.lean` is DUAL-PURPOSE — carve, do not delete.**\n\nThe genus split is *already* mostly retired: `Genus0BaseObjects.lean`, `AbelianVarietyRigidity.lean`, and `genusZeroWitness`/`positiveGenusWitness` are deleted; `Jacobian C` is uniform via `picardJacobianWitness`. The remaining T13 work is residue cleanup, with one dependency trap.\n\n**Trap — `AlgebraicJacobian/RiemannRoch/WeilDivisor.lean` serves two masters.**\n\n- Its `Scheme.PrimeDivisor` type and `Scheme.RationalMap.order : X.functionField → ℤ` valuation are the codim-1 substrate that `Albanese/CodimOneExtension.lean` (`ALB.codim1`, live north-star path) imports and uses — the `coheight = 1` convention (`CodimOneExtension.lean:177`) and the order-valuation appeal (`:1823`).\n- The `degree` / `degree_hom` / `principal_degree_zero` / `positivePart` / RR→ℙ¹ block (5 sorries, `-- Route C PAUSE`) exists only to prove the now-obsolete `genusZero_curve_iso_P1`. That block is the Route-C / genus-0 dead weight.\n\n**Consequence:** a wholesale delete of `WeilDivisor.lean` breaks the codim-1 extension build. The dependency-safe shape is a surgical carve of the RR/degree/ℙ¹ portion plus the file header (which frames the whole file around `genusZero_curve_iso_P1`), retaining the `PrimeDivisor`/`order` substrate.\n\n**Also live, not genus-0:** `RigidityLemma.lean` and blueprint `AbelianVarietyRigidity.tex` are the sorry-free rigidity-lemma + Milne §I.1–I.3 corollaries used by the uniform Albanese construction; only their \"feed the genus-0 base case (Route C)\" prose is stale — clean the prose, keep the math."
}
